original_description: Prepare well-structured git commits following the Conventional Commits specification. Use this skill when the user asks to prepare a commit, make a commit, do a commit, write a commit message, or anything similar about committing changes. It helps review unstaged changes, separate unrelated concerns into multiple commits, choose the right commit type, and write a clear, structured commit message.
best_description: Prepare well-structured git commits following the Conventional Commits specification. Use this skill when the user asks to prepare a commit, make a commit, do a commit, write a commit message, or anything similar about committing changes. It helps review unstaged changes, separate unrelated concerns into multiple commits, choose the right commit type, and write a clear, structured commit message.
final_description: Use this skill when a user wants to commit their recent code changes — whether they say "prepare a commit", "write a commit message", "help me commit this", or simply describe what they just built, fixed, or refactored and need it committed. Especially relevant when the user explicitly mentions Conventional Commits or wants to follow that format (feat/fix/refactor/chore/docs/etc.). Also handles separating mixed changes into multiple focused commits. This skill analyzes the current diff, selects the right commit type and scope, and drafts a clear commit message explaining the changes.

ok he terminado la feature de exportar a PDF. He tocado el servicio, el controlador y los tests. Haz el commit separando si tiene sentido.
